verdict.rationale: No documented public API appears in the evidence, and the OpenAPI/Swagger probes all returned 404. Probes did find a live, first-party, OAuth-gated remote MCP endpoint at mcp.reclaim.ai, which publishes an RFC 9728 discovery document with read/write/mcp scopes, so programmatic driving appears possible. However, no vendor documentation for that endpoint was found on either probe date. Missing for 10: published API reference or OpenAPI spec, vendor docs for the MCP/API surface, documented endpoints and auth setup, and hands-on evidence of driving the product through the API beyond the auth handshake.
